title: Structure-Preserving Discontinuous Galerkin Methods for Stochastic Shallow Water Equations
summary: Shallow water equations (SWE) are fundamental models in fluid dynamics that are essential for studying a wide range of geophysical and engineering phenomena. In many practical applications, uncertainties arising from initial conditions and bottom topography must be taken into account, motivating the development of stable and accurate numerical methods for stochastic SWE.
